vocab.example: I will send you a detailed quote before five o'clock today.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi sẽ gửi anh một bản báo giá chi tiết trước năm giờ chiều nay.

vocab.example: The validity period of this price is thirty days from today.
vocab.example_vi: Thời hạn hiệu lực của mức giá này là ba mươi ngày kể từ hôm nay.

vocab.example: All numbers in the table are before VAT, so please add eight percent.

vocab.example: Training is inside the scope of work, but data migration is not.
vocab.example_vi: Đào tạo nằm trong phạm vi công việc, nhưng chuyển dữ liệu thì không.

vocab.example: The subtotal is two hundred million, and tax comes after that line.
vocab.example_vi: Tổng phụ là hai trăm triệu, và thuế nằm sau dòng đó.

vocab.example: We update our price list at the start of every quarter.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi cập nhật bảng giá vào đầu mỗi quý.

vocab.example: The lead time for the licences is about two weeks after payment.
vocab.example_vi: Thời gian chờ cho các giấy phép là khoảng hai tuần sau khi thanh toán.

vocab.example: Support is a recurring fee that you pay once every year.
vocab.example_vi: Hỗ trợ là một khoản phí định kỳ mà anh trả một lần mỗi năm.

listening.title: Explaining a quote to a client

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: Good morning, Mr Khoa. Did you receive the quote I sent yesterday?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Yes, I opened it this morning, but I have a few questions.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: Please go ahead. I can walk you through the document line by line.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: The subtotal says two hundred million. Is that the final number?

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: Not yet. VAT of eight percent is added below, so the total is higher.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: I understand. And what exactly is inside the scope of work?

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: Setup, training for ten users, and one year of support are all included.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: What about the support after that first year?

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: That becomes a recurring fee, about fifteen percent of the licence value.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Fine. How long is the validity period of this price?

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Executive)
lines.text: Thirty days. After that we must use the new price list.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Then I will bring it to my director next week. Thank you, Linh.

questions.q: Why is the subtotal not the final number?
options: Because VAT is added below it
Because the price list is old

questions.q: What happens to support after the first year?
How long is the price valid?
